sentences.text: The name of the petitioner - Kaleesuwari Refinery Private Limited is called out thrice in the open Court.
There is no representation on behalf of the petitioner, either personally or through video conferencing.
The petitioner is absent.

Sri . Veeranagowda M.Biradar., learned AGA for respondents 1 & 2 and Sri.Ganesh S.Kalburgi.,
learned counsel have appeared in person.

Counsel Sri.Ganesh S.Kalburgi., submits that Sri.Deshpande.G.V., learned counsel who was attached to the office of Senior Counsel Sri.Ameet Kumar Deshpande., has filed a memo on 02.08.2023 stating that they have intimated the petitioner that the Advocate on record Sri.Ameet Kumar Deshpande., has been designated as Senior Counsel and hence, appraised the petitioner to make arrangement for appearance in the case.
Counsel therefore, submits that the memo may be placed on record and appropriate order may be passed.
Submission is noted.
Memo is placed on record.
A perusal of the memo depicts that counsel Sri.Deshpande.G.V., has communicated to the petitioner to make arrangement for appearance in the case.
The petition is listed today by printing the name of the petitioner in the cause-list.

As already noted above, though the name of the petitioner is called out thrice in the open Court,
there is no representation on behalf of the petitioner, either personally or through video conferencing.
The petitioner is absent.
The petitioner has not made any efforts to engage other advocate or to appear before the Court.
Hence, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
